title: Intent to Sole Source – Ricoh OEM Printer Ink (P/N 12X8201)
agency: TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE > INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE > SOUTHEAST REGION
description:
The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis to  Ricoh USA, Inc. , in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR 12.102(a). 

 The requirement is for  900 bags of genuine Ricoh InfoPrint 5000 Dye Plus V2 Black Ink, Part Number 12X8201 , for delivery to IRS facilities in Detroit, Michigan (360 bags), and Ogden, Utah (540 bags). 

 Ricoh USA, Inc. has confirmed that no resellers are available for the required OEM ink. Delivery is required as soon as possible, but no later than 30 calendar days after purchase order issuance. 

 All responsible sources may submit a quotation or capability statement for consideration by the Government. 

  Solicitation Number:  ITPS270019 
 Quotation Deadline:  Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. EST 
 Contract Specialist:  Zsaque L. Custis 
 Email:  zsaque.l.custis2@irs.gov 

 The solicitation and supporting sole-source determination are attached to this notice.
